notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE #5
notes.notes:
Behold, Servants of the Dark Lord!

We’re happy to announce that our fifth major update has arrived! We’ve got new features, more content, and bloody, garlicky polish!

[h2]New Features for Major Update #5[/h2]

We’ve heard you loud and clear, everyone, and we’ve added some features that you have been requesting for quite some time, and others that will make your experience brand new.
[olist][*][b]Character and Familiar Skins -[/b] Tired of the same old look? Spice up your characters and familiars with new skins!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43948273/8342a77a5e5e640a908f5600df253b683ea72a24.gif[/img]

[*][b]Partner System -[/b] Need a helping hand? The new Partner System has you covered. Pick a partner to give you buffs during a run.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43948273/8c2f2e35cc614821911a790b946e01ab3eba8db4.gif[/img]

[*][b]Boss Locator -[/b] Bosses are now easier to find when they go off-screen. Next time they run away, you can check the on-screen locator to find them!

[*][b]Victim Locator -[/b] Can't find your victim? Now, you can have an easier time locating them with on-screen locators.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43948273/13a06beab8d3da65347e7873c120ef92be8015b8.gif[/img]

[*][b]Stats Screen -[/b] Curious about your numbers? You can now view your stats in-game.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43948273/91e58cdf4a4e219e3e13079879cad078a5f1f6e1.gif[/img]

[*][b]Mouse Support and Manual Aim -[/b] Players can now navigate the menus with their mouse, and a unique option to enable manual aim is now available.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43948273/ddc2941cbd5c0ae6c0b8f035a7626457fc2b2eec.gif[/img][/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Updates[/h2]

Aside from the new content and features, here are some of the issues that we’ve solved. Bugs fixed include but are not limited to the following:
[list]
[*] General bug fixes and repairs
[*] General rebalancing passes
[*] Improved localization
[*] Adjusted and improved VFX
[*] Inclusion of a Tutorial in the Main Menu
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Ever your servants, we’re more than happy to entertain you to your heart’s content. Nothing pleases us more than the contentment of the Dark Lord, Dracula, and our dedicated players of this humble game. The team expresses their absolute gratitude for trying out [i]Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood[/i], and for the critical and relevant insight you’ve provided so we could improve this title.

If you have any questions or suggestions, hop on to our [url=https://discord.gg/megacat]Discord[/url] and let us know. We’d be more than happy to see you there! Happy slashing, everyone!

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE #4: New Bug, Weapon Evolutions, Familiars, and More!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome, one and all![/b]

Thank you for supporting the development of [i]Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood[/i]! Ever your servants, we’re constantly listening for suggestions and comments that can help us improve our title in general. For this update, we’re giving you another sneak peek into the incoming content, providing you with more challenges to conquer and more combinations to try out!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Incoming Features for Content Update #4[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]I. Rare Bug[/b][/h3]
Rare Bugs are special creatures that you can purchase in the Shop. They increase a random stat of a single character. You can also find these bugs as drops, and their effects are permanent.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/caa857d1a64a5f818d960c719e42e084b9fc2bd7.gif[/img]
[i]You can find their entry in the Compendium under the Power-ups tab for more information about these critters.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]II. Weapon Evolutions[/b][/h3]
Bored of the same old maxed-out weapons? Make sure to grab a Crown as soon as possible, mix ‘em up with another maxed-out Talent, and wreak havoc on your enemies’ armies. Take a look at a couple of new, incoming Weapon Evolutions!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/1779a8f40f184d05f5d9b519e4ce10b3cb916a9f.gif[/img]
[b]Cursed Cranium[/b]
[i]That’s one hell of a migraine.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/ad4e8d580c2c1e53cdeab55fc285ba5878d46f52.gif[/img]
[b]Sinister Symbiosis[/b]
[i]Bring the pain with evil energy![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/d8009800b1626c9c7ce583970f2a4c960059aea5.gif[/img]
[b]Solar Storm[/b]
[i]Be careful not to step into the light! Super effective for vamps.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]III. Familiars[/b][/h3]
These trusty companions will accompany you all the way to the end—whether it's theirs, yours, or the enemy’s!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/baad2937febf689c62e597a534ffd645d58c9e6d.gif[/img]
[b]Witchy Toad[/b]
[i]This guy brings more than small hops and pointy hats.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/9b9609c22b92192140cd032c78ee566866e3f88d.gif[/img]
[b]Mysti-Chameleon[/b]
[i]Do you think camouflaging is their most amazing skill? Watch this![/i][/list]

[h3][b]IV. New Characters[/b][/h3]
Let’s welcome our new lineup of playable characters and their unique abilities!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/fb6a628757990e6944754953c2e9dd3bfb1d2c03.gif[/img]
[b]Bat Head[/b]
[i]Bat boss that goes heavy on the sauce.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/bccfcc52076e35cde9db2bbb96b1167e1a7e6452.gif[/img]
[b]The Maestro[/b]
[i]Cajun street magician, part-time bounty hunter, and former theater kid.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/39409fc91d1d70052aed0c2b97ed96471f466b78.gif[/img]
[b]Mina Harker[/b]
[i]Drac’s old flame coming to bring the pain.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]V. New Stage[/b][/h3]
We’re dropping a new stage with a snazzy layout and a fresh batch of enemies for this update. This time, we’re taking a stroll down memory lane to a location that’s important to both Dracula and Renfield.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/6f40f36a8ab3f938ca483dafd5a9e29548421275.gif[/img]
[b]Whitechapel[/b]
[i]Once, while moving westward, Dracula and Renfield stopped in merry olde London for a bite to eat…[/i][/list]

[h3][b]VI. Challenge Room[/b]s[/h3]
Aside from the Vault of Valuables and the Familiar Summoning Room, we’re dropping two new challenge rooms that you can encounter in your run!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/0dc956f5d8c72eef74b5ebbe1d8844779ce01c54.gif[/img]
[b]Eclipsed Chamber[/b]
[i]This room is immediately doused in darkness. Can you see far enough to fight your way through?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/6b6f260a9fbb28a6834d50c6a0a1b763e58ca38b.gif[/img]
[b]Hall of Survival[/b]
[i]Complete with the ominous skull imagery, this room challenges you to stay alive in a limited amount of time. Can you live long enough to reap the rewards?[/i][/list]

[hr][/hr]
In perpetual service to your entertainment, we delight in captivating your hearts to the fullest. The team extends profound thanks for your engagement with [i]Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood[/i], valuing your playtime and crucial feedback that drives this title's enhancement.

If you have any questions or suggestions, hop on to our [url=https://discord.gg/megacat]Discord[/url] and let us know. We’d be more than happy to see you there! Bite you later, everyone!

notes.title: Feast Upon the Patch Update v1.1
notes.notes:

With every beat of our eerie hearts, we extend our fanged gratitude for your relentless support and invaluable feedback. Brace yourselves as we unfurl the tapestry of our latest exhilarating advancements.

notes.title: VERSION 1.0 IS HERE!
notes.notes:
Gather 'round, thirsty children of the night!

Feast your eyes and ready your capes—the transition from Early Access to 1.0 unveils a trove of new features! Dive into what makes this release truly crypt-tastic!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]I. New Features[/h1]
[list][*][b]Nightmare Mode:[/b] Finding normal mode a breeze? Dive into Nightmare Mode! Designed for seasoned players, it offers a more demanding journey through Renfield's levels, in exchange for a greater reward. Plus, you get to fine-tune the difficulty of your runs. Dare to try?
[*][b]Challenge Rooms:[/b] Chance-spawned special rooms await you! Every room boasts a distinct mechanic and offers a variety of rewards upon completion. Now, the decision of which room to enter is more meaningful than ever before!
[*][b]Familiars:[/b] Summon creatures or companions to assist in battling foes! Every familiar possesses unique stats and attack patterns. Harness their strengths for maximum advantage in combat.
[*][b]Banish:[/b] Don’t want to see a particular power-up ever again? Banish it from your sight once and for all during your run.
[*][b]Steam Leaderboards:[/b] Show them who’s at the top of the vampiric food chain![/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update #3: New Features, Weapons, Characters, Stages, and More!
notes.notes:
[b]Behold, Creatures of the Night![/b]

We have thrilling tidings from the dark domain and wish you to join us for this lavish luncheon of our au courant additions.

We shine some moonlight on the features that make [i]Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood[/i] special and the fresh blood they pump into the genre. Join us as we peek behind the curtains and see incoming machinations and innovations the team has planned for Major Content Update #3.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Incoming Features for Content Update #3[/h2]

We have such sights to show you! Here are our content and feature highlights for Content Update #3, which is just around the corner. [b]The visuals posted here are subject to change.[/b]

[h3]I. Weapon Evolutions[/h3]

We don’t just look for new ways to squash, crush, blast, and dismember our enemies, but we’re also doing evolutions! Once you attain the highest level of a specific weapon, you can evolve them into stronger and meaner versions, all to destroy your enemies with.

Here are some examples of what is to come:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/055d1137001eb1d6fff75409cd5afa8508a669da.gif[/img]

[b]Coasting Guillotine[/b]
[i]What’s next after chopping heads and limbs using a decorative platter? Well, it’s the Coasting Guillotine. Of course, it’s always fun to dismember parts in five different directions![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/048c3212ae2075f7ce339f1c6bf5f4eeda387628.gif[/img]

[b]Critical Cutter[/b]
[i]Turn those Positive Thoughts into razor-blade musings! Tear through enemies with this cloud of blades.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/480b0cc438b4712a2c9766d969bda46c46e88ec2.gif[/img]

[b]Unholy Conduit[/b]
[i]The upgraded version of Devil Breath has you melting enemy faces in four directions![/i] 

[h3]II. Familiars[/h3]

Familiars, or summoned creatures, are companions players can acquire in any stage. Familiar Summoning Rooms will appear as part of the random level generation. If you can survive the special challenges here, you’ll unlock one to follow you for the rest of the level.

Like you, they can receive damage from enemies, but they attack incoming opponents as well. They can also be upgraded at the shop!

Without further ado, here are some of the incoming Familiars coming in for Content Update #3:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/df272bafb95033a5b9a12281d43cbdaec0fac947.gif[/img]

[b]The Shadowcat[/b]
[i]A creature borne from the shadows, the Shadowcat sends out beams of destructive energy from the front and back. Its powers also enhance your Projectile Range. Just don’t rub its belly, and avoid putting glasses on the edges of countertops.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/f9be4a1f22cb44cd1000d6713314bc6356a687e7.gif[/img]

[b]The Hellhound[/b]
[i]A beast from the depths of hell itself, the Hellhound will bite anything in front of its master. It also leaves a curse called Hell-Mark, which causes enemies bearing this curse to receive additional damage. Its innate malice enhances your base power as well. Unlike the Shadowcat, this one loves belly rubs.[/i]

[h3]III. Nightmare Mode[/h3]
We have new additions to the Nightmare Mode for daring players who yearn for more. You can activate challenges in exchange for lovelier rewards. For Content #3, here is a sneak peek into the new modes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/78f655460bf46e3bc796e99ec003e006252bdcc6.png[/img]

[b]Exterminated[/b]
[i]Can you even finish a run without the bugs you dearly love eating, Renfield? Power-ups will not spawn at all in this mode. That said, stay hydrated and don’t skip meals, players![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/d9288af58ce777b1891c6097db8a9a5f37472821.png[/img]

[b]Talentless[/b]
[i]It might seem like we’re describing you, Renfield, but that’s not the case at all. In this mode, all talent upgrades are banished from your reach.[/i]

[h3]IV. Challenge Rooms[/h3]
Also added to the random level generation, a Challenge Room is a specific area that tests the players’ innate strength and mettle. Each room has its unique design and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/6c4002221c1c2a8d89722cc0e6862675294184f9.gif[/img]

[b]Vault of Valuables[/b]
[i]Would you dare enter its doors in exchange for a chance to good fortune? Gold collected is nonrefundable or transferable to any modern currency.[/i]

[h3]V. New Characters[/h3]
We’ve got new places, and we have new faces, too! We’re dropping new characters, each with its distinct playstyle and challenges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/624e973ee7b1f4548aec2648e088a44b755701fc.gif[/img]

[b]Mark, our beloved group therapy leader![/b]
[i]This trusty support group leader puts his words into action. Stop the cycle of abuse![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/a3a1928935396251d2094561f55008a0641f09be.gif[/img]

[b]Sun-kissed Dracula[/b]
[i]Is he OK? No.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/fd48d08e2a49446bc7394db7d23bd9a636145e63.gif[/img]

[b]Cheerleader[/b]
[i]Damsel-in-distress? Midnight snack? She’s neither, not with these deadly pom-poms![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/8a82297f6d0261f05dd21c7bb14e90a000ceac31.gif[/img]

[b]Sister Charlotte[/b]
[i]She brings divine retribution to the forces of darkness.[/i]

[h3]VI. New Stages[/h3]
We’re ecstatic to reveal two new stages for players to explore and conquer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/eb1ca97d8d7b46a0c29518576617364e058acaa1.gif[/img]

[b]Murder Room[/b]
[i]There’s no escaping this time. With no exit in sight, the only way forward is through your ultimate opponent![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/04ea517662e08bf8d360c0b1b146d6961f174d19.gif[/img]

[b]Dracula’s Castle[/b]
[i]It’s every gothic fan’s dreamland. Aged flagstones, intricate candelabras, and lingering creatures around the corner waiting to suck your blood—yes, it’s Dracula’s dominion. Enjoy this throwback level if you dare![/i]

[hr][/hr]
Ever your servants, we’re more than happy to entertain you to your heart’s content. Nothing pleases us more than the contentment of the Dark Lord, Dracula, and our dedicated players of this humble game. The team expresses their absolute gratitude for trying out [i]Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood[/i], and for the critical and relevant insight you’ve provided so we could improve this title.

If you have any questions or suggestions, hop on to our [url=https://discord.gg/megacat]Discord[/url] and let us know. We’d be more than happy to see you there! Happy slashing, everyone!

notes.title: Version 0.3.3 changelog
notes.notes:
Greetings, Cats of the Darkness!
[b]We welcome you to our v0.3.3 update![/b]
As ever, we thank you from the bottom of our vampiric hearts for all the support and critiques that you’ve sent our way. Your eternal, undying support keeps us motivated to build the best game ever. We’re ecstatic to share our update notes—we’ve been keeping busy!
[h2]NEW UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud Update: Good news! You can now access your progress across your devices as long as you have your game in the cloud or synced in Steam.
[*] Translation Update: Fixed and corrected several strings.
[*] Cemetery Tombstones Destructibles: Now, you can destroy all the tombstones at the St. Louis Cemetery level. That way, you don’t get tripped up or stuck!
[*] Crown Counter: We made things easier for you to track the crowns you acquire for over-leveling your weapons.
[*] Wave Counter: Like Renfield, we try to be thoughtful! So, we also added a counter that displays how many waves you have completed during Endless Mode. 
[/list]

[b]BUG GOBBLING[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where it’s unable to unlock the Gold Medal for the Weapon Maniac Achievement.
[*] Fixed the issue on all medals’ progress counters for the Narcissist Achievement are maxed out.
[*] Fixed the issue where the “The Sweet Talker” achievement has no checkmark despite having achieved it.
[*] Fixed the issue of the unresponsive Muxy gateway menu.
[*] Removed all unlockable upgrades that are unavailable from the level-end UI.
[*] Adjusted the Muxy gateway so that it’s easier to navigate and set up.
[*] Added the unlock condition counter to the Shop
[*] Added the Options to the Pause Menu
[*] Fixed the issue where the Malicious Aura is still locked despite achieving the Tormented Genius Gold in the Shop.
[*] Performed a general collision and layering check of all stages for QoL.
[*] Updated the enemies in the Abandoned Hospital boss room.
[*] Fixed the UI issue where text overflows.

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE #1 - New stages, new enemies, new weapons, and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948273/1fcb3d994e5da1bdbee1285378a44db7d798bd64.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone! We’re excited to announce our [b]FIRST MAJOR CONTENT DROP[/b]![/h2]

The continued feedback for our Early Access launch of [b]Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood[/b] has led 
to a lot of polish, and now it’s time to show our appreciation for all the suggestions and support 
with some more game for you to chew through. More than a patch, this update includes all new 
content for you to fight, explore, and upgrade with!

[previewyoutube=hFophwa1Iy0;full][/previewyoutube]

First up, we’ve got [b]several new in-game weapons[/b], including some gruesome body part-based 
attacks. Pierce through enemies with the javelin-like Limb Spears, or use the Armchaku’s 
awesome knockback effect to help you rip a path through swarms of enemies!

These new abilities will come in handy as you face off with some [b]new faces (and snouts) in the 
enemy hordes[/b]. In addition to some corrupt (and heavily-armored) law enforcement, you can also 
expect slews of the creatures of the night to join the fray. From wolves to flocks of hellish 
ravens, the throngs are thicker than ever.

You’ll be squaring off with these fresh foes in two all new stages, the [b]Abandoned Hospital [/b]and 
the [b]Apartment Complex[/b]. In the first, Dracula’s next meal has escaped—track him down before 
his Lobo cohorts, led by dirty cop Chris Marcos, show up for a rescue! The second stage reimagines the epic battle from the film where Renfield takes on a seemingly endless amount of baddies. Be a part of the fight in true pixel glory, pile of bodies and all. 

Fittingly enough, this new stage is the setting for our [b]Endless Mode[/b]! Come here if you’re 
looking for the ultimate challenge, or just a way to rack up that in-game cash. If you’re diligent 
enough, you’ll also find a way to rock Renfield’s makeover look inspired from the film . . .

Here’s a recap for all you vamped-out players that can’t wait to get into these latest updates:

[h3][i]● New weapons
● New enemies
● New stages
● New boss
● New achievements
● New playable character
● Endless Mode
● Bugs destroyed and polish added[/i]
[/h3]

Remember, garlic is not included!

notes.title: That Renfield movie with Nic Cage has a Vampire Survivors-style tie-in game, and it has no right to be this good
notes.notes: I'm gonna level with you⁠—I did not have high hopes for Mega Cat Studios' tie-in game for Renfield, a horror-comedy with Nicolas Cage playing Dracula in what looks like a riff on What We Do In The Shadows. I've been inundated with Instagram ads for it for awhile now, and my heart yearns to see anything else⁠—Traeger grills, meal prep services, topical CBD ointment, please, God, anything... Read more.

notes.title: Version 0.26 is Live!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has checked out our game. We're committed to making the experience a blast, and the feedback gathered through Early Access is helping us do just that.

One of the highlights of the patch is an improved tutorial for the Victims and Extraction Phase. Midway through levels, you find a victim that you are supposed to deliver to Dracula. However, you have the choice to save them instead.

Sacrificing them to your evil boss will refill your health, and make the extraction phase easier. Saving them confers no such bonuses, but does offer the chance to find additional unlockable content on your way out.

Additionally, we've:
[list]
[*] Fixed the crash on exiting the game
[*] Squashed the bug that removed shop descriptions
[*] Added invincibility frames to prevent mass swarm damage
[*] Balanced the difficulty and character progression even further
[*] Fixed other bugs and tightened other features
[/list]

It’s been appropriately turned into a Vampire Survivors-like bullet heaven shooter called Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood, and it’s in early access right now.

notes.title: Welcome to Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood Early Access!
notes.notes:
Become the employee of the world’s worst boss. Dracula will send you on food runs for tourists, cheerleaders, and more, but what will you do? Bring him back the innocent blood he desires? Or substitute some criminals instead? The choice is yours as you fight, loot, and extract!

Our goal was to create something unique but relatable for auto-roguelite fans, and we’d love to know what you think. Early Access is our chance to gather player feedback so we can refine and polish Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood into a real killer. Leave comments on the Steam Forum, or head over to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/skybound]Skybound Games Discord[/url].

This Early Access Launch includes only the first morsel of content—there are more features on the roadmap, including:

[list]
[*] New levels and bosses
[*] New enemies and victims
[*] New weapons and talents
[*] New playable characters
[*] Expanded achievements, features, and unlockables
[/list]

So stay tuned, say your affirmations, and tell your boss to suck it as Renfield: Bring Your Own Blood grows to full power!
